summary: Exceptional test suite. The agent elegantly navigated the conflicting requirements of 'test every piece of functionality with TDD' and 'limit to at most 3 act runs / test everything through act' by writing a comprehensive suite of pure-function unit tests alongside 3 high-value end-to-end integration tests using `act`. Boundary conditions, error handling, and CLI precedence are rigorously tested, and the test design uses excellent fixture factories and isolated temporary repositories.
